title: Pesto Chicken Subs with Swiss & Hot Honey
summary: A meal-prep batch of 12 subs: pesto chicken in hollowed-out baguettes with melted Swiss and hot honey. The video gives only four tips for making them lighter and keeps the actual recipe for a paid cookbook.

ingredients.item: Homemade pesto, made with minimal oil

steps.text: Trim the fat off the chicken.
Make the pesto with as little oil as possible.
Build 12 subs: pesto chicken, melted Swiss and hot honey.

nutrition.note: The voiceover claims 50 g protein per sub; the description says 43 g. The cost claim is $3.25 per sub (spoken).

notes: The full recipe is sold as a $34.99 PDF cookbook through a link in the creator's bio. Treat this card as a starting point and fill in the method yourself.
